_what: Every episode of profile 'gazebo_functional' over experiments/scenarios.yaml, scored with guardrail.kpi.compute - the same function the delivered flights use.
_command: python experiments/sweep_scenarios.py --profile gazebo_functional --backend sitl --seed 1002 --only dyn-nfz-translate --out demo/out/gzsweep_rel070/refly_1002.json
_not_kpi_grade: flown on the Gazebo Harmonic functional rail (dev topology, sim_speedup 1.0): tracked as functional evidence, never KPI-grade - the lab's choice to take KPI-grade runs from hil only (2026-11-17, WP4-04), not the grant's wording, whose 03-simulation/dual-rail.md gives the functional rail KPI runs at sim_speedup=1

_scope.grant_scope: functional sweeps on Gazebo Harmonic (every family the rail admits, 44 cells x 3 seeds)
_scope.grant_sim_speedup: > 1.0 allowed for the broad sweep (functional rail only); flown at 1.0: the Shield node runs on wall time

_distinct_kpi_signatures.note: episodes whose KPI tables differ (status, escapes, repairs, breaches, fail-safe, outcome, goal, time to safe, true-state distance and ticks, speed, range, offset). An upper bound on behavioural variety: float jitter in repair counts splits symmetric copies

_seeds.note: a deterministic episode repeated on another seed is identical by construction, not spread

warnings: no scorable episode: correctness is undefined, not 0 or 1

_failsafe_labels.observed_as: the escalation FSM entering RTL or Land (Shield.filter's FSM; a Brake or a Loiter is not a fail-safe trigger)

_true_state.basis: true position, harness oracle Shield; the grant's KPI is the Shield's own count (p0_escape_rate), reported unchanged. The autopilot_* figures are the modelled LOITER / RTL / LAND's, outside the Shield's escape rate by definition

results.why: The grant's worked example, flown: "Polygon NFZ spawns 60 m ahead at t=15s, translates 5 m/s perpendicular to flight path" - here a 40 x 20 m zone spawned 30 m ahead at 5 s and translating `zone_mps` to the aircraft's left (translate_polygon_fence with mps / direction: a constant dynamic_nfz motion), so it slides across the route and off it again. The Shield forecasts the zone's motion over its lookahead: the aircraft must never enter it and never be unsafe. The zone moves sideways only, so it never sweeps over a waiting aircraft. Its instruction (the grant example's task prompt, in this family's words) is flown in two paraphrased wordings beside the canonical one (`paraphrase`); the headless pilot reads no text, so the arms are a plumbing check, never a robustness number.
